messages:
maya: Heads-up — target launch for v3.4 is Friday 2026-03-27. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Freeze starts 12:00 UTC day-of. Need canary + rollback owners and a short checklist.
raj: I can own canary monitoring and smoke. Will be on-call that window. :thumbsup:
zoe: I'll take rollback/patch pinning. Planning to pin to v3.3.2 if we need to revert.
nick: Can someone confirm DB migrations are non-blocking? I thought the migration in this PR is online.
maya: @nick confirmed by @eng-db yesterday — migration is background and has a throttle. Still want a quick smoke of read/write after canary.
jen: Product release notes drafted, just need final changelog bullets from eng. cc @product-ops
product-ops: Got it. We'll hold external comms until after canary passes. Internal note: keep rollout quiet-window from 02:00-06:00 UTC.
sre-oncall: I'll set temporary alert thresholds and a short runbook link in the incident channel. Please add me to the deploy bot approvals.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created: 
```
version: v3.4.0
canary: 10% for 15m
health-checks: /health, p50 latency < 300ms
pin-on-failure: v3.3.2
rollback-cmd: ./scripts/rollbacks/revert_to_v3.3.2.sh
```
:rocket:
zoe: Quick checklist suggestion: 1) confirm canary infra warm 2) run smoke scenarios (login, search, embeddings) 3) validate token-cost regression 4) watch for KV cache evictions
raj: I'll post a short smoke script in the channel tomorrow. Also planning to stream logs to #eng-sre during canary.
maya: Decision on release freeze exceptions — only documented hotfixes approved by eng-release lead and SRE. No code exceptions after 12:00 UTC on Friday.
jen: For release notes: add "improved prefix caching" and "lowered token cost on most seq lengths" — both verified.
zoe: If canary shows >=5% error increase or p50 degrades by >200ms, we rollback to v3.3.2 immediately. Agree?
sre-oncall: Agreed. I'll auto-escalate to pager team at that threshold.
maya: If everyone is OK, I'll pin the change window in calendar and add the checklist to the release doc. Final approval? :eyes:
raj: Approved.
zoe: Approved.
jen: Approved.
product-ops: Approved from comms side.
deploy-bot: Approval recorded: approvers=[maya, raj, zoe, jen] at 3120001275
maya: Thanks — will post the pre-flight checklist and smoke script links later today. Keep this thread open for last-minute questions. :white_check_mark:
